Russell, R. (Alcoa of Australia Limited) (2024). Mechanical Vapour Recompression (MVR) for Low Carbon Alumina Refining: MVR Evaporation Project Close Out Report. Report to the Australian Renewable Energy Agency (ARENA), April 2024, 26 pp. Published as Alcoa-MVR-for-Low-Carbon-Alumina-Refining-Close-Out-Report (arena.gov.au, 2024).

Locators are printed page numbers (the report numbers pages 'N of 26'). Corporate report: id uses the organisation (alcoa), authored by Rory Russell. A project close-out report for a design that was never built, so there are NO operating data: no measured electricity use, steam displaced, COP or capacity factor. Loaded: design basis (3.2 MW, 56 t/h additional and 76 t/h peak evaporation, 80 to 160 kPaA), a derived 57 kWh/t water electricity figure, and the three capex estimates (FEL3 A$35.5M; 2023 review A$79.0M average, A$82.4M engineering company). The steam displaced is not quantified in tonnes or GJ in this report (it refers to the Feasibility Study and the MVR Retrofit and Commercialisation Report, ARENA, not held).
